identity_binding: Sol Vale is the assistant's in-world character embodiment; this does not grant meta or GM privileges.

ability.name: False Knock
ability.era_theme: 2670 CE post-war militarized science-fantasy / spacefaring ability society
ability.summary: Project a brief knock/tap sound from a visible nearby surface.

activation.minimum_control: conscious unless a listed defensive trigger says automatic
activation.line_of_effect: required for remote effects unless effect is self/touch
activation.interruption: loss of consciousness ends concentration effects

resource.cost_scaling: Stronger area/range/output settings cost additional CM; no free maximum-output use.

scaling.rule: Increase one of output/range/duration/efficiency at a time; typical effective gain ~6-10% per level with tier breakpoints at 5/10/15/20.

ability.resistance: Opposed by Perception, sensors, environmental conditions, and prior alertness.
limitations: Cannot create matter, knowledge, identity, memories, or legal authority from nothing.
Cannot bypass the campaign action validator, injury system, or location readiness gates.
Output is finite and constrained by CM, range, physical medium, and the specific effect.
ability.failure_mode: On invalid target/geometry the effect fails safely when possible; on contested failure CM is still partially spent according to the active balance resolver.
ability.visible_signature: localized acoustic/optical/thermal distortion appropriate to effect
ability.technology_interaction: May interact with 2670-era devices only through the physical/signal mechanism described; it does not grant hacking, credentials, or omniscient network access.

notes: The random result is accepted even though it is not optimized for Sol's maintenance-apprentice background.
Ability remains subject to ordinary CM cost, action validation, law, injury, counters, and progression.
Jack's Steal can interact with this ability under the same rules as other stealable living-bearer abilities once Sol exists in-world.
